lines.say: Black Friday. Your store is down, and nothing is even broken. The reviews just got slow.
lines.show: Black Friday. Your store is [down,] and nothing is even broken. The reviews just got [slow.]

lines.say: Every product page waits for reviews from another server. The waiting work piles up until your store stops loading.
lines.show: Every product page *waits* for reviews from another server. The waiting work *piles up* until your store [stops loading.]

lines.say: A circuit breaker in your house cuts the power when something goes wrong. In software, it stops requests to the struggling server.
lines.show: A *circuit breaker* in your house cuts the *power* when something goes wrong. In software, it *stops requests* to the [struggling server.]

lines.say: Too many slow or failed requests? It pauses new requests for a while.
lines.show: Too many slow or failed requests? It *pauses* new requests for a while.

lines.say: Your code decides what happens instead: skip the reviews and load the rest of the page.
lines.show: Your code decides what happens instead: *skip the reviews* and load the rest of the page.

lines.say: Later, it lets a few test requests through. Fast again? Resume. Otherwise, it pauses again.
lines.show: Later, it lets a *few* test requests through. *Fast again? Resume.* Otherwise, it pauses again.

lines.say: That keeps one slow feature from taking down your whole app.
lines.show: That keeps one slow feature from *taking down your whole app.*

lines.say: If AI writes your code, follow for the system design it leaves out.
lines.show: If AI writes your code, *follow* for the system design it [leaves out.]
